title: ASRock Steel Legend SL-1200P power supply review: Combines genuine Platinum efficiency with a winning stand-out design
summary: The ASRock Steel Legend SL-1200P is a strong contender in the high-wattage modular PSU segment. The accessory bundle is genuinely good: mounting screws, an AC cable, cable ties, reusable cable straps, a jump-start adapter for bench testing, and clear cable combs.
